headline: MiCo fairs wind down; USB rail strike starts at 21:00
taxi: CityLife at opening and closing; Centrale and Garibaldi late evening as trains are cut.
linate: Moderate business traffic; some travellers switching from rail to air ahead of Friday's strike.

headline: USB general strike: rail cut until 20:59, taxis listed; ATM and flights protected by holiday franchise
taxi: Possibly fewer taxis all day while the metro runs; stations busy, then Friday-evening centre demand.
linate: Long-weekend departures and derby fans arriving; flights protected 30 Oct–5 Nov.

headline: Derby AC Milan – Inter at 20:45 (~75,000) on Halloween night
taxi: San Siro 22:45–00:30, then centre nightlife until late: busiest night of the week.
linate: Long weekend (All Saints, Sun 1 Nov): Saturday departures and arrivals.

headline: All Saints' Day (Sunday): quiet city after the derby night
taxi: Light demand; station returns in the evening.
linate: Evening returns from the long weekend; Bob Dylan fans arrive for Monday.

headline: Bob Dylan at Unipol Dome Santa Giulia; EICMA exhibitors arrive
linate: Busy: EICMA trade visitors and exhibitors fly in ahead of Tue 3 Nov press days.

headline: EICMA press/trade days start at Rho, plus SMAU and Marco Masini
taxi: Rho Fiera at 08:30 opening and 18:30 closing; Assago exits around 23:30; centre in the evening.
linate: Very busy: international EICMA trade visitors arriving.

headline: EICMA trade days at Rho plus SMAU at MiCo
taxi: Rho Fiera at 08:30 and 18:30; CityLife at closing; hotels and centre in the evening.
linate: Very busy: EICMA trade visitors and exhibitors; arrivals ahead of Thursday's public opening.

headline: EICMA public days open, SIRM radiology congress starts and AC Milan – Ferencváros at 18:45
taxi: Rho Fiera all day; San Siro arrivals 17:00–18:45 and exits 20:45–21:30 overlap MiCo closing on the west side.
linate: Very busy: radiology delegates, EICMA visitors and Hungarian away fans.
